basics.name: Prasad Gade
basics.label: Data Scientist & Computer Engineer
basics.summary: Data Scientist and Computer Engineer from Mumbai, India. B.Tech student at Sardar Patel Institute of Technology (CGPA 9.37/10), published researcher, and hackathon winner. Builds data pipelines, ML systems, dashboards, and interactive web applications.

education.institution: Bhartiya Vidya Bhavan's Sardar Patel Institute of Technology
education.minor: Management from SPJIMR (S. P. Jain Institute of Management & Research)

highlights: Architected and developed an end-to-end data-intelligence pipeline using Python, delivering a functional MVP that consolidates unstructured document, web, and structured-data workflows into reproducible JSON, CSV, and Markdown outputs

Achieved 91.7% correctness on manually verified answer-bearing document extractions by combining Docling page-level provenance, section-aware retrieval, local Ollama inference, deterministic Python post-processing, and automated validation

Engineered a citation-grounded research agent using LangGraph, Pydantic, DDGS/SearXNG, Trafilatura, Playwright, pypdf, and Ollama, implementing query rewriting, source ranking, caching, bounded retries, and quote-level verification with zero pipeline errors

Automated the ingestion and normalization of heterogeneous CSV, XLSX, DOC, PDF, and HTML inputs using Python and Openpyxl, producing auditable outputs with strict evidence provenance, missing-data classification, and validation logs

Built automated ETL workflows using Python (Pandas, Openpyxl) and PowerShell to ingest, clean, and classify unstructured institutional data, generating 50+ faculty-specific PDF reports for departmental review

Spearheaded advanced academic typesetting by compiling a 130-page Ph.D. thesis on Quantum-Inspired Machine Learning and Hyperspectral Imagery using LaTeX and TikZ, managing modular chapter builds and strict version control
Architected a scalable student achievement analytics system, transforming raw survey datasets into dynamic Excel dashboards, automated Markdown portfolios, and actionable KPIs for departmental review

Streamlined academic compliance by managing complex Outcome-Based Education (OBE) frameworks, mapping CO-PO correlations, and accelerating research publication workflows via custom VBA macros for IEEE and IJETT journals
Worked on data analysis and business intelligence workflows using Power BI, including data cleaning, visualization design, and dashboard development for business datasets
Built an interactive sales dashboard for the Northwind Traders dataset by analyzing sales, customer, product, and regional trends, enabling clearer business performance tracking in Power BI

projects.name: GraphShield
projects.description: Real-Data Graph ML for Financial Fraud Detection
highlights: Built a leakage-safe graph ML research pipeline on DGraphFin with 3.7M nodes, 4.3M edges, 17 node features, and official supervised splits of 857,899 train, 183,862 validation, and 183,840 test nodes

Implemented and evaluated GraphShield, a dual-path spectral GNN with low-pass/high-pass graph filters, against GraphSAGE, logistic regression, XGBoost, and prior baselines under extreme fraud-class imbalance

Ran 6-seed real-data ablations showing GraphShield reached 0.0415 AUC-PR and 0.7748 AUC-ROC; removing low-pass, high-pass, or graph structure reduced AUC-PR to 0.0215, 0.0274, and 0.0264, respectively

Added paired-bootstrap testing with 300 resamples, held-out conformal calibration, temporal/OOD drift diagnostics, and research-contract tests to prevent synthetic data, split leakage, and test-threshold selection

projects.name: IPL Analytics Platform
highlights: Engineered a 3-stage IPL data pipeline over 278,205 ball-by-ball records from 18 seasons, producing a feature parquet plus 18 aggregate parquet datasets for fast analytics
Built a 15-page Streamlit app backed by 19 DuckDB views, including player, team, venue, matchup, phase, records, tournament, and match-level analysis for 1,169 IPL matches

Implemented a deterministic semantic search engine that compiles supported cricket questions into whitelisted SQL, ships with 40 example prompts, and exposes assumptions plus generated SQL instead of guessing unsupported requests
Added a schema-driven per-visual control system and expanded regression coverage to 52 pytest checks to keep interactive filters and statistics aligned across the analytics pages

projects.name: UPI Analytics Platform
highlights: Processed 9,026 JSON files from 3 sources across 788 districts and 42 months using a 4-stage medallion pipeline into a DuckDB star schema (4 dim + 4 fact tables)
Quantified market duopoly via HHI, measured geographic inequality using Gini coefficients, and segmented adoption tiers with K-Means across 788 districts
Forecasted UPI volumes using Prophet and ARIMA; delivered 68 visualizations across 11-tab Streamlit and Power BI dashboards, validated by 83 tests via GitHub Actions CI/CD

projects.name: Lex Simulacra
highlights: Built an 8-agent legal courtroom simulator using LangGraph, modeling judge, prosecutor, defense, legal researcher, citation verifier, evidence reviewer, summarizer, and witness-style workflows with stateful multi-turn debate

Designed a retrieval-augmented generation pipeline over 100K+ legal documents using BM25 re-ranking and ChromaDB vector indexing to retrieve case-relevant context and generate citation-grounded responses
Improved context relevance by 3.2x through query refinement, context compression, hallucination checks, and citation validation, exposed through a real-time Streamlit interface with FastAPI SSE

projects.name: Intrusion Detection
highlights: Benchmarked 6 ML/DL models (Decision Tree, XGBoost, Transformer, Autoencoder, Logistic Regression, Naive Bayes) on the 8.6M-sample TII-SSRC-23 intrusion detection dataset using a leakage-safe stratified train-test split
Achieved 99.99% test accuracy, 99.99% precision, and 100.00% rounded recall with the best Decision Tree model, reducing missed attacks to 13 false negatives on a 1.29M-sample test set
Handled extreme 1:6653 class imbalance using stratified evaluation, threshold tuning, and SMOTE-based resampling for selected baseline models such as Logistic Regression and Naive Bayes

Showed that the Decision Tree trained 12.8x faster than the Transformer baseline (4.7 vs 60 min) while delivering 20x higher inference throughput and stronger interpretability through SHAP and decision-path analysis

projects.name: KindHearts
highlights: Reduced donation request processing time by 60% by building a modular SPA with dedicated dashboards and protected routing
Boosted platform engagement by 45% by integrating real-time request tracking, MetaMask-based crypto payments, and impact reporting
Enhanced operational efficiency by implementing a Kanban-style system for shopkeepers and comprehensive admin controls

projects.name: Celestial Classifier
highlights: Achieved 99.07% accuracy (0.99 F1) classifying 10,000 celestial objects into stars, galaxies, and quasars by engineering 10 features with color-indices and log-redshift
Improved Neural Network accuracy from 95.13% to 98.78% using Keras Tuner across 10 trials, optimizing a 96-32-16-3 architecture with tuned hyperparameters
Benchmarked 4 classifiers (DT: 87.75%, KNN: 94%, NN: 99%, RF: 99.07%) on 3,000 test samples via GridSearchCV with 5-fold CV and 960+ fits

projects.name: NutriSnap
highlights: Enabled 85% faster logging experience and 95% accurate nutrient estimates by integrating Gemini API to analyze food images or manual entries
Implemented daily calorie and macro goals with interactive dashboards and visual trend analytics
Supported dual input modes (image/manual) with local SQLite storage

projects.name: Audio Visualizer
highlights: Built a real-time audio visualization web app using the Web Audio API, improving playback responsiveness by 70%
Added multiple dynamic visualization modes (bars, radial waves, scatter plots) with customizable color schemes, boosting engagement by 55%
Deployed a fully client-side solution on GitHub Pages with file upload and microphone input support

projects.name: Attendance Tracker
highlights: Built subject-wise reports, student-wise analysis, editable records, and real-time visualization for attendance trends and percentage summaries
Implemented offline-first architecture using IndexedDB (Dexie.js) with seamless sync after reconnection
Added import/export of records, data backups, and secure local storage management

projects.name: Habit Tracker
highlights: Built streaks, calendar views, analytics, and contribution-style visualizations
Leveraged IndexedDB (via Dexie.js) for persistent offline storage, ensuring data privacy without server dependency
Applied shadcn/ui and Tailwind with Zustand for state management, ensuring scalability and maintainability

projects.name: Portfolio
highlights: Built a personal portfolio with four themes, a Minecraft skin viewer, and a paper physics playground
Added static JSON APIs, agent discovery files, and llms.txt support for machine readability
Designed the site to show both technical work and personality
